state_design.source: existing frozen 32-state input bank for each case
state_design.reset_rule: restore the same pretrained checkpoint, carrier value, and zero AdamW moments before each two-state group; advance only the repair carrier and moments within a group
state_design.claim_boundary: groups are independent frozen input streams conditional on one checkpoint and cold-start AdamW; they are not independent training runs or checkpoints

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.moments: zero at the start of each group and normally evolved for its second state

large_vector_summary.rule: use exact coordinates when dimension is at most 4096; otherwise report the primary sketch and require the direction of every reported conclusion to agree across all three seeds

inference.confidence_interval: 95% Student interval over the eight confirmation input-stream groups
inference.multiplicity_family: five cases times three stages times three predeclared effect branches
inference.headline_rule: a branch is confirmed only when its interval excludes zero, the calibration direction repeats when required, its family-adjusted p is at most 0.05, and all large-vector summaries agree on direction

controls.determinism: repeat the candidate path from the same state for the first state of every group
controls.repair_boundary: record runtime source identity, call count, shapes, and repair mode for every state
controls.failure_policy: missing or non-unique boundary, changed forward loss for backward-only repair, absent carrier gradient, or summary disagreement produces ABSTAIN

prohibited_reuse: historical case labels and long-run outcomes may not change thresholds, branch definitions, split, sketch seeds, or multiplicity family
